description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the SavingsAccountCharge entity, providing methods to query charges related to savings accounts, including specific lookup and pending charges retrieval.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for CRUD operations and custom queries on SavingsAccountCharge entities.

methods.name: findByIdAndSavingsAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves a savings account charge by its ID and associated savings account ID.

methods.name: findPendingCharges
methods.description: Finds all due savings account charges that are not paid or waived up to a specific transaction date.

calls: select sac from SavingsAccountCharge sac where sac.id =:id and sac.savingsAccount.id = :savingsAccountId
select sac from SavingsAccountCharge sac where sac.dueDate <=:transactionDate and sac.waived = false and sac.paid=false order by sac.dueDate
